roles.whyIntro: Women and girls in Kakuma Refugee Camp face many challenges, including financial hardship, interrupted education, limited access to skills training, and barriers to employment and healthcare. For teenage mothers, these challenges can be even greater as they balance childcare with their education and personal development. At Women Without Borders Hub, we believe every girl and young woman deserves the opportunity to overcome these barriers, discover her potential, and build a better future. By promoting education, practical skills, mentorship, health awareness, and economic empowerment, we aim to create opportunities for women and girls to grow in confidence, strengthen their independence, and contribute to their communities.

common.whyIntro: Haweenka iyo gabdhaha ku nool Kakuma Refugee Camp waxay la kulmaan caqabado badan, sida dhaqaale yari, waxbarasho hakad gasha, fursado kooban oo tababar xirfadeed ah, iyo caqabado ku wajahan shaqo helidda iyo daryeelka caafimaadka. Hooyooyinka da’da yar waxaa intaas u dheer inay isku dheelli tiraan daryeelka carruurta, waxbarashada iyo horumarkooda. Women Without Borders Hub waxay aaminsan tahay in gabar kasta iyo haweeney kasta oo da’ yar ay mudan tahay fursad ay caqabadaha uga gudubto, awooddeeda ku ogaato, mustaqbal wanaagsanna ku dhisato. Annagoo dhiirrigelinayna waxbarashada, xirfadaha wax-ku-oolka ah, hagidda, wacyiga caafimaadka iyo awood-siinta dhaqaale, waxaan doonaynaa in haweenka iyo gabdhuhu kalsooni yeeshaan, madaxbannaanidooda xoojiyaan, bulshadoodana wax ku biiriyaan.

quoteSection.quote2: I founded Women Without Borders Hub because I believe that every girl and young woman deserves a chance to create a better future, regardless of the challenges she faces. Too many talented young women have dreams that remain out of reach because of financial hardship, limited opportunities, and barriers that hold them back. I want to help change that by creating opportunities for learning, empowerment, and personal growth, where every girl can discover her strengths, find her voice, and move forward with confidence.

contact.partnerText1: Women Without Borders Hub waa urur xaafidi ah oo ku shaqeeya kambiida Kakuma, Kenya. Wana ku soo dhaweeyaan dad, urur, foundation, maaliyade iyo saaxiibada la wadaagayo waxay ka qeexaan commit-ment yn uu xoojinay haweena iyo da'qadaha ka jira haystaha noloshumaanka iyo meelaha lagu qaado.
contact.partnerText2: Iyadoo aan barasho iyo xarfidda, talo-barasho, horumarka xirfadaha dhijitali ah iyo kuwa practical, barashada caafimaadta nadiifka, caawinta caafimaadka jinsiyada iyo isu-ubka iyo xoojinta dhaqaalaha ahaa, waxaan ka caawisaa gabayaha sida badan, hooyoyinka da'da iyo da'qadaha jiray sida ku habboon inay kalsoonaan, horumaraan xirfadaha iyo helaan fursado mustaqbalkii.
contact.partnerText3: Waxaan ku soo dhaweeyaan shaqooyin taas oo xoojinaya barnaamijyadeena oo ka caawisa inay tirsanayaan caqabadaha waxbarashada, horumarka shakhsiga iyo fursada dhaqaalaha ahaa. Haddii ay tahay deyn, khibrad arrimo, tababar, khad, ama tallaabooyin wada shaqo, taageeradaadu waxay ka caawin karnaa inaan abuurno fursado badan oo bulshadaha aan u shaqeyno.
contact.partnerText4: Isku darka, waxaan karnaa inaan kor u qaado sharaf, ku wanaajin, adag iyo fursado joogto ah, taasoo u ogolaan in gabayaha iyo da'qadaha jiray ay mustaqbalkooda u qaabeeyaan waxayna si togan ugu qayb qaadaan bulshadahooda.
contact.getInTouchText: Waxaan ku soo dhaweeyaan codsiyada shaqooyinka, wada shaqaynta barnaamijyada iyo fursada inaan isku shaqeeyno.
contact.closingText: Isku darka, waxaan karnaa inaan abuurno fursado oo gabayaha iyo da'qadaha jiray ay wax u bartaan, kora na ay kulmaan.

about.heading: About
about.paragraph: Women Without Borders Hub is a community-led organization in Kakuma, Turkana County, Kenya, creating opportunities for vulnerable girls, teenage mothers and young women.
about.partnersText: We partner with schools, training institutions, health providers, NGOs, development organizations, donors and private-sector partners — adapting each programme to local needs while holding consistent standards for quality and safeguarding.

getInvolvedCards.intro: Waxaa jira siyaabo badan oo aad ku taageeri karto himiladeenna: waqtigaaga iskaa wax u qabso ugu bixi, xirfadahaaga la wadaag, taageero dhaqaale bixi, haweenka da’da yar hag, ama nala samee iskaashi. Wax ku biirin kastaa waa muhiim, waxayna ballaarin kartaa fursadaha waxbarasho, xirfad-barasho, wacyiga caafimaadka iyo dhaqaalaha ee haweenka iyo gabdhaha ku nool Kakuma Refugee Camp. Wadajir, waxaan u gudbi karnaa caqabadaha, dhisi karnaa kalsooni, abuuri karnaa mustaqbal ay gabar iyo haweeney kasta oo da’ yar ku kobci karto.
